application_sentences: Exhibitions PSD 450 1 / 4 PagesView full catalog PSD 450 Product catalog summary Pendulum Impact Tester PSd 450 Overview The Pendulum Impact Tester PSd 450 is designed for conducting Charpy impact tests on metals, Izod impact bending tests, and optionally impact tensile tests or Brugger-based tests.

Applications The tester complies with DIN EN ISO 148, part 2, and is suitable for notched-bar impact tests on steel and other metals according to various standards including DIN EN ISO 148, DIN 50 115, ISO 83, GOST 9454-78, GOST 10708, and ASTM E23.
For larger specimen batches, an automated testing system can be used for transport and automatic testing of the specimens.
For all robotic testing systems, the autoEdition3 automation software is used for information input and control.
Equipment for testing metals, including hardness testers, universal testing machines, impact testers and metallography.
Equipment for testing plastics, including tensile, flexural, compression, impact and hardness testing systems.
Equipment for testing rubber, including hardness, abrasion, rebound, rheometry and flex testing systems.
Equipment for testing textiles, leather and footwear, covering tear, burst, colour fastness, abrasion and flex.
A high pressure steam autoclave for testing the soundness and expansion of cement to ASTM C151.
Equipment for testing cement and concrete, including mixers, curing chambers, Vicat and Blaine apparatus.
A large direct shear machine for testing geosynthetics and soils to ASTM D5321.
An automatic rock core grinder that prepares flat, parallel specimen ends for testing.
These devices are the most optimal for testing the strength of impact resistance for a certain material, when in collision with a specified load.
The position of the notch is meant to concentrate the stress onto a specific location on the material, and provokes a delicate failure for testing purposes.
